questions.answer: where to hang
questions.question:

| hang | plant | order | place |

I bought a new painting, but I can't decide _______________ it.
questions.explanation: '어디에 걸지'라는 의미가 필요하므로 where와 hang(걸다)을 결합한 'where to hang'이 정답입니다. 그림을 걸 장소를 결정하지 못했다는 문맥에서 where가 적합합니다.

questions.answer: what we should cook for the party
questions.question:

<보기>
We don't know where to put the sofa.
→ We don't know where we should put the sofa.

We haven't decided what to cook for the party.
→ We haven't decided ___.
questions.explanation: 'what to cook'는 주어 we를 넣어 'what we should/could cook'으로 확장하며, should(해야 할지)와 could(할 수 있을지) 둘 다 의미상 자연스럽게 쓰입니다.
acceptedAnswers: what we could cook for the party
What we should cook for the party
What we could cook for the party

A: 내가 너라면, 불필요한 불을 끌 거야.

I were you, I'd turn off the lights.

questions.answer: Mina hasn't decided what to cook tonight yet.
questions.question:
다음 우리말에 맞게 주어진 단어를 바르게 배열하시오.

Mina는 오늘 저녁에 무엇을 만들지 아직 정하지 않았다.
(hasn't, what, tonight, yet, to, decided, cook, Mina)
questions.explanation: '무엇을 만들지 아직 정하지 않았다'는 「hasn't decided + what + to부정사」 구조이며, yet은 부정문에서 문장 끝에 위치합니다. 현재완료 부정형(hasn't decided)과 「의문사 + to부정사」가 함께 쓰인 구조입니다.
acceptedAnswers: Mina hasn't decided what to cook tonight yet
Mina has not decided what to cook tonight yet.
Mina has not decided what to cook tonight yet
Mina hasn’t decided what to cook tonight yet
